name: KAOS All-in-one Strategy
trend: last completed 4h close above EMA200 and EMA50 above EMA200 for long; reverse for short
entry: 1h candle touches EMA20-EMA50 zone; within six completed entry bars bullish close above prior high and EMA20 (reverse short); setup cancelled if higher trend changes or an unscheduled quote gap occurs
entry_fill: next observed hourly open; cancel if more than 0.25 signal ATR away from confirmation close or more than four days late
stop: pullback low/high plus 0.25 Wilder ATR14 buffer; fixed stop
target: 2 times entry-to-stop distance from actual entry fill
ema: SMA seed, then standard recursive EMA; higher trend available only at completed higher-bar end
stock_sessions: Yahoo regular-session schedule; 4h groups anchored at session open, final shorter group completes at actual session close
crypto_forex_sessions: UTC four-hour groups requiring four complete hourly observations
exposure: one position and at most 1x gross notional per independently funded instrument sleeve; whole ETF shares; equal starting sleeves, no leverage or reallocation; portfolio risk below 1% under intended stops

directions.crypto: spot long only; no short funding assumption

stocks.dividends: gross reported cash distributions credited if held before ex-date; no tax modeling

forex.carry: conservative calendar-time cost, not observed broker swap

intrabar: gap stops fill at observed open; simultaneous stop and target uses stop first; target gaps receive no favorable price improvement
end: force liquidation at final available close; no fabricated last quote
stress: same frozen rules and signals, doubled adverse fills/commissions/forex carry
selection: one fixed strategy, no tuning or instrument removal after evaluation; report 2025 and later 2026 results separately, later starts flat with prior indicators
scope_limits: no options contracts, binary expiry/payout claims, taxes, news blackout filter or specific broker fills; USDJPY quote PnL converted to USD at exit, USDT assumed at USD parity
